newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weaker on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weaker on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against both the dollar and the pound on Friday, dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean commercial rate of 20.069 against the dollar from 20.049 on Thursday. The rupee traded at a mean of 33.7025 for one pound from 33.6725 on Thursday.
Dealers said the rupee was fixed weaker against the dollar to follow the firmer U.S. currency in international markets.

They added foreign exchange reserves in commercial banks were more or less square at the moment after the central bank's interventions in the interbank forex market during the past week and lower demand from importers.
The central bank was seen selling dollars to commercial banks on Monday and Wednesday over the week.

"There is no big demand from importers on the commercial side. End of year festivities imports are now more or less over at this period of year. Importers demand is principally for basic commodities such as food items," said one dealer.
